item.title: UK defense shortfalls highlighted as Britain avoids Iran offensive role amid Trump criticism
item.description: While Starmer opposed joining offensive action against Iran, reports suggest politics aside, Britain’s military may lack the capacity for a major combat role.

item.title: Non-Jewish professor says he was fired for calling out Hamas supporters in online post
item.description: Canadian professor Paul Finlayson says he was fired for defending Israel on social media amid a wave of antisemitism following the Oct. 7 attacks.

item.title: New Ebola outbreak leaves 65 dead as officials warn of cross-border spread
item.description: A new Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed 65 people with 246 suspected cases as officials investigate which strain is driving the deadly spread.

item.title: Lebanon accuses Iran of inserting IRGC terrorists into country 'under guise of diplomatic activity'
item.description: Lebanon reportedly filed a precedent-setting UN complaint against Iran amid U.S.-facilitated Israel-Lebanon normalization talks in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Hamas used sexual violence 'deliberately and systematically' on Oct 7, commission report finds
item.description: Investigators say Hamas perpetrators deliberately used sexual and gender-based violence as a weapon during the Oct. 7 massacres in southern Israel.

item.title: Ship seized off coast of UAE near Strait of Hormuz may have been 'floating armory': report
item.description: UKMTO reports a ship was boarded by unauthorized personnel near the Strait of Hormuz off the UAE coast and headed toward Iranian territorial waters.

item.title: Trump faces split among retired US commanders over whether to resume Iran strikes
item.description: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on "massive life support" as retired U.S. commanders debate whether to resume military operations against Tehran.

item.title: Iran says its small subs deployed to Strait of Hormuz as expert explains threat: ‘Vulnerable to detection’
item.description: Iran claims it has deployed small submarines as an "invisible guardian" of the Strait of Hormuz, but analyst says the vessels pose limited strategic threat.

item.title: Islamabad denies sheltering Iran jets, Trump praises Pakistan's mediation as 'absolutely great'
item.description: Pakistan denies allowing Iranian aircraft to use its airfields amid U.S.-Iran tensions. President Donald Trump says Pakistani mediation efforts have been "great."

item.title: Taiwan watches Trump-Xi meeting for signs China will test US resolve
item.description: Experts say Xi Jinping may seek to influence President Trump to make certain concessions over Taiwan in exchange for cooperation on tariffs, fentanyl and global flashpoints like Iran.
